data.body: Operator decision 2026-11-02: option (18). Add one grouping call over a review's BLOCKING findings, run only when there are 2 or more, modelled on the bakeoff's step-B set-level grouping (LINKAGE.md section 2-3: one call sees all findings and returns groups; no pairwise votes, no transitive chaining). Groups stamp the existing citric-alert-dogfish fields (group_id, is_primary, group_criteria); every member keeps decision=block and only the CLI collapses. A finding may belong to at most one group. Advisory findings stay out of scope. Supersedes the lexical fix_unit_key grouping, which never fired (0 of 9,756 sidecars).
